name: Stargate Abilene JV (Crusoe / Blue Owl / Primary Digital Infrastructure)
monetization: The $15B joint venture that owns and is building the 1.2GW flagship Stargate campus in Abilene, TX; income is lease payments from Oracle, which operates the site for OpenAI workloads.
description_md: Joint venture sponsored by Crusoe, funds managed by Blue Owl Capital's Real Assets platform, and Primary Digital Infrastructure. Phase 1 (two buildings) was funded from 2024; the second phase (May 2025) expanded the JV to ~$15B and eight buildings, each designed to run up to 50,000 NVIDIA GB200 NVL72s on one network fabric. Construction is debt-financed via JPMorgan-led loans ($2.3B phase 1, $7.1B phase 2). Abilene is the flagship site of the OpenAI/Oracle/SoftBank Stargate program.

observations.notes: Debt and equity committed across both phases.
